base.title: Base
base.description: With `label`, `placeholder` and in-menu search. `searchPlaceholder` and `noResultsText` translate the search copy.

multiple.title: Multiple
multiple.description: `multiple` shows the selection as chips and `defaultValue` takes an array.

withDescriptions.title: With descriptions
withDescriptions.description: `description` adds secondary text to each option and `disabled` locks it.

withoutSearch.title: Without search
withoutSearch.description: `searchable={false}` removes the search field; the menu is keyboard driven.

clearable.title: Clearable
clearable.description: `clearable` shows a button to empty the field when there is a selection.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: `isDisabled` locks the trigger and the hidden form inputs.

error.title: Error
error.description: `errorMessage` forces the error border and shows the message with role="alert".

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Three sizes: sm, md and lg.

borders.title: Borders
borders.description: `border` sets the trigger tone. Forced to error when the field is invalid.

withTooltip.title: With tooltip
withTooltip.description: `infoText` adds an info icon in the label row, aligned to the right edge of the field.

texts.label: Workspace

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: Drive the value with `value` and `onChange`. In single mode `onChange` receives a string.

controlledMultiple.title: Controlled multiple

fieldMapping.title: Field mapping

header.description: API reference for the Select React component: props, CSS classes, tokens and exported types.

import.title: Import

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Besides the documented props, Select accepts native <button> attributes (ButtonHTMLAttributes) except onChange, value, defaultValue and size. They go to the trigger; className goes to the trigger and wrapperClassName to the root. With name, hidden <input type="hidden"> elements (one per value) submit the selection in a form. The menu renders in a portal in body (or the closest <dialog>).

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.trigger: The trigger is a <button> with aria-haspopup="listbox", aria-expanded and aria-controls.
a11y.listbox: The list uses role="listbox" (with aria-multiselectable in multiple mode), aria-activedescendant, and each row role="option" with aria-selected.
a11y.keyboard: Enter, Space or ArrowDown open the menu; arrows, Home and End move; Enter picks and Escape closes and restores focus.
a11y.label: The label names the trigger through aria-labelledby. With no visible label, pass aria-label. helperText and errorMessage are linked through aria-describedby.
a11y.copy: The accessible names of the clear button (Clear) and chip remove buttons (Remove …) and the loading copy are fixed in English.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Class names applied based on props. Menu classes live in body, outside the root.

rules.trigger: Button that opens the menu. Receives `className`.
rules.actions: Container for clear, spinner and chevron.
rules.menuTop: Menu opened upwards for lack of space.
rules.optionActive: Option active via keyboard or mouse.
rules.optionTick: Check of the selected option in single mode.
rules.check: Checkbox of each option in multiple mode.
rules.open: Applied while the menu is open.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Select has no variables of its own: it uses these gem-system tokens. Redefine them on your `wrapperClassName` to change the trigger; the menu lives in body, so to style it redefine them on a shared ancestor (or globally).

items.--gem-color-border: Border of the trigger, menu and search row.
items.--gem-color-accent: Border while the menu is open.
items.--gem-shadow-focus: Focus ring while the menu is open.
items.--gem-color-bg: Background of the trigger and menu.
items.--gem-color-bg-subtle: Background of chips, active option and disabled trigger.
items.--gem-color-fg: Text of the value, chips and options.
items.--gem-color-fg-muted: Placeholder, icons, descriptions and helper text.
items.--gem-color-primary-600: Check of the selected option and checked boxes.
items.--gem-radius-md: Radius of the trigger and menu.
items.--gem-radius-sm: Radius of chips, options and the clear button.
items.--gem-font-sans: Font family of the field and menu.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: It also accepts native <button> attributes (except onChange, value, defaultValue and size). Select is generic: T is the shape of each option.

items.options: Menu options. Objects of any shape are supported.
items.multiple: Allows more than one selected option.
items.searchable: Shows a search field inside the menu.
items.clearable: Shows a button to clear the selection.
items.clearLabel: Accessible name of the clear button. Defaults to "Clear".
items.optionValue: Field or getter for each option value.
items.optionLabel: Field or getter for the visible label.
items.optionDisabled: Field or getter that disables an option.
items.optionDescription: Field or getter for secondary text.
items.optionSearchText: Field or getter used by the search.
items.label: Visible field label.
items.noResultsText: Copy when the filter matches no options.
items.helperText: Helper text below (hidden when `errorMessage` is shown).
items.errorMessage: Error message. Marks the field as invalid.
items.infoText: Shows an info icon next to the label.
items.infoLabel: Accessible name of the info icon.
items.border: Border tone. Forced to error when the field is invalid.
items.isLoading: Shows a spinner and blocks the menu.
items.isRequired: Marks the field as required (aria-required + asterisk).
items.name: Name of the hidden inputs for forms.
items.id: Trigger id and base for internal ids.
items.aria-label: Accessible name when there is no label.
items.wrapperClassName: Extra classes for the root container.
items.onChange: Receives the new value: string in single mode, string[] with `multiple`.
items.onInfoClick: Fires when the info icon is activated.
items.onClear: Fires after the selection is cleared with the button.
